card.title: Delegate Downward
card.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're my deputy. You'll answer the inspector's complaints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Most of them concern decisions you made.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. You handle the details below decision-making level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The inspector wants whoever signs the replies at tomorrow's hearing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign as deputy, then. You can represent me without giving the impression we're equals.

mechanism: A assigns complaints and hearing responsibility through deputy status while preserving the distinction from decision-making equality.
confusable: Unlike sharing accountability, A must use B's lower rank to make B own the unwanted execution.
comparison: D53-b uses the deputy signature to send B to a hearing; D53-a uses senior-subordinate status to keep B for the plumber and lockup.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
